item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00247","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C14","C22","C01"],"selected_candidate_label":"C14","confidence":0.96,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C14 plausibly supplied a concrete template: both proclamations recite a legal instrument that makes a tariff or tax consequence depend on a presidential finding after consultation with a foreign government, announce that the previously exceptional supply or trade condition has terminated, and make the ordinary duty or tax applicable on the thirtieth day following the proclamation. C22 and C01 also terminate or defer earlier fiscal measures, but lack this distinctive consultation-and-finding machinery.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"after consultation with the President of the Philippines ... have found that such adequate supplies are now readily available","parent_excerpt":"after consultation with the Government of the Oriental Republic of Uruguay and with the Argentine Government, do proclaim that the abnormal situation in respect of the trade in flaxseed ... has terminated","explanation":"Both use consultation with specified foreign governments followed by a presidential finding that the condition supporting exceptional tariff treatment has ended."},{"child_excerpt":"Upon the expiration of 30 days after the date of this proclamation the suspension ... will be terminated so that ... the processing tax ... will be applicable.","parent_excerpt":"with a view to making applicable to flaxseed the rate of duty of 50 cents per bushel of 56 pounds on the thirtieth day following this proclamation","explanation":"Both impose the renewed fiscal consequence exactly thirty days after the proclamation."},{"child_excerpt":"adequate supplies of neither copra nor coconut oil ... were readily available ... [but] such adequate supplies are now readily available","parent_excerpt":"the abnormal situation in respect of the trade in flaxseed ... has terminated","explanation":"The operative factual transition is substantially parallel: a prior abnormal market or supply condition ends, triggering restoration of ordinary tax or duty treatment."}]}
